Thanks Akiko — super helpful context and congrats on surviving Golden Week!

High-level: we want to make this demo useful for both APAC engineering and Europe product/security. A couple of notes on scheduling:
- US/Europe DST: both Redwood US and EU teams are on DST in May, so offsets are currently PDT (UTC-7) and CEST (UTC+2). That means your Tue May 11, 09:00 JST slot lines up with Mon May 10 17:00 PDT and Tue May 11 01:00 CEST — slightly late for Europe.
- Given Golden Week, if your Japan team prefers to avoid the week of May 4, we can shift to the week of May 11.

Our suggested options that balance APAC-friendly times with Europe not too late:
A) Tue May 11, 09:00 JST / Mon May 10, 17:00 PDT / Tue May 11, 01:00 CEST (APAC-prioritized)
B) Wed May 12, 14:00 JST / Wed May 12, 06:00 PDT / Wed May 12, 07:00 CEST (midday APAC / early EU)
C) Thu May 13, 16:00 CEST / Fri May 14, 00:00 JST / Thu May 13, 07:00 PDT (EU-prioritized)

I've attached a quick availability .ics with the slots we can hold tentatively — please let us know which you prefer and I'll send a firm invite with the demo deck attached.

Also looping in Rafael and Vivek to check the candidate times for the demo environment (we may need to reserve extra capacity for a multi-region demo to show routing fallbacks).

Cheers,
